summary: Inspected 12 representative files spanning main weight files (Weight_24.lean, Weight_26.lean, Weight_52.lean, Weight_112.lean) and part files (Weight_42_part_1.lean, Weight_52_part_0.lean, Weight_100_part_7.lean, Weight_58_part_0.lean, Weight_62_part_0.lean, Weight_68_part_4.lean, Weight_70_part_2.lean, Weight_74_part_2.lean, Weight_84_part_4.lean, Weight_86_part_0.lean, Weight_88_part_0.lean). All files contain formal mathematical content: definitions of Hecke field minimal polynomials, modular forms as Eisenstein series combinations, q-expansion coefficient lemmas, Sturm-bound uniqueness theorems, and heavy integer-arithmetic certificates (decide +kernel). None are pure import aggregators or navigation-only files.
